front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《 4 》

en: From legends of ancient times
Tracing one's own DNA
Let there be reincarnation, one's life no longer a riddle

points.zh:
《 我們流著不同的血液 》 林媽利  著 ,   2010。
以血型，基因的科學證據，揭開台灣各族群身世之謎。
DNA不會說謊，它清楚明白地告訴我們 :
( 1 )  85%的「台灣人」帶有原住民的血緣。
( 2 )  「唐山公」其實是中國東南沿海的越族。
( 3 )  平埔族沒有消失，只是溶入「台灣人」之中。
( 4 )  高山原住民非同源，台壪原住民和夏威夷原住民有共同的母系祖先。
points.en:
"We Carry Different Blood," by Lin Ma-li, 2010.
Using scientific evidence from blood types and genetics, this book uncovers the mystery of the origins of Taiwan's various ethnic groups.
DNA does not lie; it tells us clearly:
(1) 85% of "Taiwanese people" carry Indigenous ancestry.
(2) The "Tangshan grandfathers" (mainland Chinese forebears) were in fact members of the Yue peoples of China's southeastern coast.
(3) The Pingpu (Plains Indigenous) peoples have not disappeared; they have simply been absorbed into the "Taiwanese people."
(4) The mountain Indigenous peoples do not share a single common origin; Taiwan's Indigenous peoples and the Indigenous peoples of Hawaii share a common maternal ancestry.

en: In the early summer of the flower shadow mother-in-law
In the dusk of autumn,
There's a place called Once Upon a Time

zh: 遠方天空燃起一片晚霞
en: In the distant sky, a sheet of evening glow catches fire
"These days, I have long been unable to set out"
Once the journey begins, it will arrive

zh: 讓這一季浪花持續跳躍
於是 ， 我的眼裡有你的美麗
en: We, in the name of love
Let this season's sea-foam keep on leaping
And so, in my eyes there is your beauty
Some blues are a deep, deep blue
The blue of the Aegean Sea
Waiting for Venus's blue

points.zh: 《維納斯的誕生》是義大利文藝復興時期畫家桑德羅·波提切利 (  Sandro Botticelli, 1445-1510 ) 最著名的作品之一，描述希臘羅馬神話裡，女神維納斯從愛琴海中誕生的情景：她赤裸著身子踩在一個貝殼之上，右邊春之女神正在爲她披上華服，而左邊的風神送來暖風陣陣，吹起她的髮絲。寧靜的海面，遼濶的藍天，溫馨而祥和····。維納斯是愛與美的女神，生下來就是完美無缺的，畫面的形象是那樣的清淡秀美，神秘中帶著優雅，神往中透出嫵媚。《維納斯的誕生》目前存放在佛羅倫斯的烏菲茲美術館中。
points.en: "The Birth of Venus" is one of the most famous works of the Italian Renaissance painter Sandro Botticelli (1445-1510), depicting the scene from Greek and Roman mythology in which the goddess Venus is born from the Aegean Sea: she stands naked upon a shell, while on the right the goddess of spring is draping fine robes over her, and on the left the wind god sends warm gusts of breeze that lift her hair. The calm sea, the vast blue sky, warm and serene… Venus is the goddess of love and beauty, born perfect and flawless; the imagery of the painting is delicate and lovely, mysterious yet touched with grace, entrancing yet tinged with charm. "The Birth of Venus" is currently held in the Uffizi Gallery in Florence.

zh: 踼踏   踼踏   一路去
en: Wooden clogs
Clip-clop, clip-clop, all the way
The bottom of childhood's alley
Hot tea
Every mouthful holds its own distinct flavor
The past is like smoke
Something glittering in the distance
Is still the most precious dream
The scenery one hoped for
The years have hastened, and it is already late
I, at this moment
Can it be beyond a thousand mountains?
At night comes the sound of wind and rain
Who knows how many blossoms have fallen
The Buddha bends low, holds up a flower, and smiles

points.zh:
春眠不覺曉，處處聞啼鳥。
夜來風雨聲，花落知多少。
--唐  。孟浩然《春曉》
《佛祖拈花  迦葉微笑》
佛祖拈花微笑典出于《五灯会元》卷一。据载：世尊在靈山會上，拈花示衆，是時衆皆默然，唯迦葉尊者破顏微笑。世尊曰：“ 吾有正法眼藏，涅盤妙心，實相無相，微妙法門，不立文字，教外别傳，付嘱摩柯迦葉“。
佛祖所傳的是一種至爲祥和、寧静、安閑、美妙的心境，這種心境純淨無染、淡然豁達、無欲無貪、無拘無束、坦然自得、不着形迹、超脱一切、與世長存，是一種“無相”、“涅盤”的最高的境界，只能感悟和領會，不能用言語表達。而迦葉的微微一笑，正是因爲他領悟到了這種境界，所以佛祖把衣鉢傳给了他。衣是袈裟，鉢是食具，衣鉢代表佛教的法统。
points.en:
In spring sleep, unaware of dawn, everywhere the birds are heard crying.
The sound of wind and rain came in the night; who knows how many blossoms have fallen.
-- Tang dynasty. Meng Haoran, 'Spring Dawn'
'The Buddha Held Up a Flower, and Kasyapa Smiled'
The story of the Buddha holding up a flower and Kasyapa smiling comes from the first fascicle of the 'Compendium of the Five Lamps' (Wudeng Huiyuan). It records: the World-Honored One, at the assembly on Vulture Peak, held up a flower to show the congregation; at that time all the assembly remained silent, only the Venerable Kasyapa broke into a smile. The World-Honored One said: "I possess the treasury of the true Dharma eye, the wondrous mind of Nirvana, the formless form of reality, the subtle Dharma gate, not established on words, a special transmission outside the scriptures — I entrust it to Mahakasyapa."
What the Buddha transmitted was a state of mind supremely serene, tranquil, at ease, and wondrous — a state of mind pure and unstained, calm and open, free of desire and craving, unbound and unrestrained, at peace and self-content, unattached to appearances, transcending all things, abiding eternally with the world — a state of "formlessness" and "nirvana" at the highest level, which can only be intuited and understood, not expressed in words. And Kasyapa's slight smile was precisely because he had grasped this state, and so the Buddha transmitted the robe and bowl to him. The robe is the kasaya, the bowl is the alms bowl; robe and bowl together represent the orthodox lineage of the Buddhist Dharma.
